context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 37 tested Document Quality Control System feature. Backend endpoint POST /api/documents/validate validates file metadata (filename, size, mime_type) without actual file upload - it's a JSON-based validation API. Frontend DocumentUploader component performs client-side validation matching backend rules. Admin can notify clients about rejected documents via POST /api/admin/notify-document-rejected/{client_id}. The quality checklist (data-testid='quality-checklist') only appears when files are uploaded (client-side state). The 'Qualité vérifiée' badge appears when all 3 checklist items are checked. Test file: /app/backend/tests/test_document_quality_control.py
